title: Material Blend 2-Mix Trio #29 (부채꼴 4구역·매끈 / 동심원 4구역·물결 / 대각 띠 4구역·매끈)
prompt:

Her figure is divided into 4 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 51% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 4 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 8 o'clock, 10 o'clock, 12 o'clock and 4 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. The regions alternate between 2 materials in a repeating order. Region 1 is the wedge between the 8 o'clock ray and the 10 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA and VIVID SILVER panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 3 is the wedge between the 12 o'clock ray and the 4 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries the same material as Region 1. Region 4 is the wedge between the 4 o'clock ray and the 8 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries the same material as Region 2. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
